…네. 약초꾼은 입이 무거워요.\n독초가 어디 나는지도\n아무한테나 안:
…Yes. Herb-folk keep quiet.
We don't tell just anyone
where the poison herbs grow.
…A snowflake.
The court will be in uproar.
…늑대 무리는 마녀를 기억한다.\n마녀사냥 때 산을 넘게 해 준 것.\n:
…The wolf packs remember the witches.
They got us over the mountains in the hunts.
A debt belongs to the pack. To me too.
…Wolves don't weep.
They do howl at the moon.
…Not tonight, though.
…Nivel, did we not agree
not to write down others' dreams?
…If it's paid,
I've no reason to come.
…Everyone asks.
Why I never set it down.
…'Tis not different, orc.
The law was the same.
The hand froze, that's all.
…답장이라.\n고블린은 글 대신 매듭이오.\n'나 여기 있소' 한 번 감:
…A reply, then.
Goblins write in knots.
'I am here' is one wrap.
…Plain enough, yet
I'd never thought of it.
…대답은 들었소.\n오늘 밤 그 불 옆에서 자면\n조상과 같은 꿈을 꾸겠:
…I have my answer.
Sleep beside that fire tonight
and I'll dream what the ancestors dreamed.
…She's passed.
So, three tail swishes at her grave.
A fox's greeting.
…The scariest part
is before you look.
…I'm back.
That's what one says to the pack.
...Back again.
This house smells of a pack.
Not bad.
...Back again.
Your axe blade was dull.
I sharpened it.
…I'm back.
I forgot that dream a little. Yawn.
…With a witch as witness,
my master can't say a word.
…Even Mala can't price it, she says.
So it must be truly dear.
…맛있죠? 맛있다고 해요.\n아니면 국자로… 아니에요!:
…Good, isn't it? Say it's good.
Or the ladle… no, never mind!
…Hammering isn't dangerous.
A door left unfixed is.
…No lock it fits,
that's the good of it. No one
can ever lock it again.
...True, count one by one.
I counted coins while at it.
Here, exactly six.
…Keep it?
This is my brother's debt.
…Not every night.
Only on snowy ones.
So in winter I stand by the door.
…If I meant to, I'd have eaten you.
…I can stop?
Then… I'll count to ten. Slowly.
…모, 모미도요?\n그분이 토끼는 안 먹는다고\n저한테도 말했어요…:
…M- Momi too?
They told me as well
that they don't eat rabbits…
…Set the anvil down. Slept.
Dreamt of Father.
…He smiled. Father did.
…모르겠어요. 눈 떠 보니\n굴뚝 연기가 보였어요.\n지도에 문이 안 그:
...I don't know. I opened my eyes
and saw chimney smoke.
The door won't show up on my map.
…Don't know.
Grandpa never looked.
…So I'm still searching.
…몰라. 전설은 거기까지야.\n몸집일 수도, 꿀일 수도.\n…몸집은 곤란:
…Don't know. The legend stops there.
Could be size, could be honey.
…Size would be trouble. Small door.
…I can't.
It's the last root
my master tried to save.
…Not because it was heavy.
The load vanished.
In one sip of water.
…Knees ache.
Someday I can't carry it all.
…Before then, I trust one to you.
…I said I'd not speak of the pack.
Tonight I can't keep that.
…The pack left me.
In this house
we don't speak of that.
…Can I leave out the scary bit?
No? All right.
...I'll lie by the door.
I sleep lightly.
That's the pack's habit.
…Changed the latch?
…I won't bite it this time.
…The latch marks. Still there.
…You didn't replace it?
…Already paid.
Half a jar of honey.
…The bear gave it.
…My feet moved first.
I bit the door latch. Let go.
…A night messenger with a roost —
first since my grandmother.
…Big room.
Tonight I sleep beside the load.
…Not on top of it.
…Big room.
Room to lie down with the load.
...Room.
The hinges squeak.
I'll fix them in the morning.
…There won't be rooms enough.
Then I'll sleep in the stable.
…배가 고프다.\n사흘을 굶었다. 산장 음식으론 안 된다.\n목장의 검은:
...I am hungry.
Three days without food. Lodge fare won't do.
The pasture's black sheep... give me just one.
…백 년이요? 할머니, 그 책 아세요?: …A hundred years? You know it, Gran?
…I threw it out. Blade was bent.
…You use it well.
I'll set the teeth again myself.
…You saw?
Don't write it down. It's mine.
…The north pass. Half a day off.
Thank you, fox.
…She wasn't the borrower.
She was the keeper, I think.
…뼈가요? 할머니,\n제 몫도 던져 주실 수 있어요?:
…The bones? Grandmother,
could you cast for me too?
…I did not think the envoy
would remember such a thing.
…사흘 중 이틀은 제 거예요.\n셈은 제가 이겼죠?:
…Two days in three are mine.
I won the count, right?
...Shaga is disappointed.
Still, it's money from selling ash.
Take it.
…세라 씨, 지금\n누구 편이에요?:
…Mistress Sera, just
whose side are you on?
…Custom dried up.
No regrets. Not Father.
…You said guest.
Guests don't watch sheep at night.
…I watched.
…Cauldron.
Handle was loose.
Fixed it. Didn't ask.
…How many spoons was it?
I'll stop counting. Plenty.
...Refusing a drink?
Fine, I'll sell the keg.
Here's the price.
…Deep in the forest.
She went to save the roots.
She hasn't come back. Yet.
…심은 뒤에라.\n그건 못 해 봤군. 하하.\n다음엔 심어 보지!:
…After planting, eh.
Never tried that. Ha.
I'll plant one next time!
…쐐기를 박았군. 하나.\n고블린치곤…:
…Drove in a wedge. Just one.
For a goblin…
…아니, 그래서 맞겠군요.\n무섭지 않은 불도 있다고\n이제는 알려 줘야:
…No, that is why it fits.
It ought to learn now
that some fires are not cruel.
...No, I can't sleep now.
Someone has to keep watch.
...I'll hold out a little longer.
…No. They don't
know how to scold.
They only cry.
…아니오. 길잡이는 지우는 게 아니오.\n지운 사람들이 길을 잃었지.\n:
…No. You don't erase a waymark.
The ones who did got lost.
That's how I make my living.
…Father's.
The forge is gone.
Only the anvil's left.
…Father said:
'Words rust. Iron doesn't.'
…Iron rusts. He lied.
…아버지가 못 간 길이오.\n내가 가면 아버지 길이 되나,\n내 길이 되:
…A road my father couldn't walk.
If I walk it, is it his road,
or mine?
…Haven't set it down.
…Remember what you said, though.
...I won't.
If I let go, they take it.
Even here.
…안 돼요. 그건 안 돼요.\n열한 개라고 할게요.\n마녀님 말은 비싸니:
…No. That won't do.
I'll say eleven.
Your word costs too much, Witch.
…It's not for sale.
First time ever. Not naming a price.
…Surprised myself.
…안쪽 방이요.\n걱정해 주시는 거죠?\n쫓아내는 거 아니죠?:
…The inner room.
You're worried for me, right?
Not throwing me out, right?
…A den cold from the inside.
…I know.
Badgers left theirs too.
…Understood.
Stone knows how to wait.
So do I.
…Very well. I'll read the grain first.
A fold gate
opens and shuts a thousand times.
…Understood. Of the four waystations,
this is the best. That much
I'll keep to myself.
…Understood.
Watching from afar is
a night messenger's work too.
…알고 있소. 묻지도 않았소.\n돌을 지키는 집이\n돌을 보여 주면 안:
…I know. I didn't ask.
A house that keeps a stone
ought not show it.
…I'll find out. But my fee
is paid in wool. Not the wet kind.
…알았다. 기다리겠다.\n맹세 대신 이거라도 받아라.\n오크는 빈손으로:
...Understood. I'll wait.
Take this instead of the oath.
Orcs don't leave empty-handed.
…알았다. 길은 미룬다.\n순례 노잣돈이다. 받아라.\n산장이 내 길이다:
...Understood. I'll put off the path.
Here's my pilgrimage travel money. Take it.
The Lodge is my path, for now.
…알았어. 첫째, 둘째로 할게.\n근데 셋째가 제일 잘 들어.\n…헤헤,:
...Fine. I'll use the first and second.
But the third cuts best.
...Heh, joking. I won't.
…알았어요.\n근데 거품은 제 식으로 낼래요.\n그건 아무도 모를 거예요:
…All right.
But the foam I'll do my way.
No one will ever know.
…알았어요. 대신 주인을\n못 찾은 건 어떡해요?\n그건 제가 맡아 둬도:
…All right. But what about
things whose owners I can't find?
Can I hold on to those?
…알았어요. 동전은 받고\n그 동전으로 내일 고기 사 와요.\n결국 솥으:
…Fine. I take the coin
and buy meat with it tomorrow.
It all comes back to the pot. Hah!
…The promise was 'I will guide.'
Not 'I will follow in secret.'
...Oh, your pouch is empty.
There's nothing to toss.
I shouldn't have said anything.
…That's better, isn't it?
Everyone says so.
…열한 개요. 그쵸?\n열하나도 대단하죠?:
…Eleven. Right?
Eleven's grand too, isn't it?
…옆에요? 네!\n옆이면 안 도망쳐요.\n도망칠 데가 없으니까요!:
...By your side? Yes!
By your side I won't run.
There's nowhere to run to!
…Tonight, the door again.
…I'll keep my back to the sheep.
…Tonight I shall sleep it through.
No.
…I'll sleep it through.
…If he comes, charge him double.
I'll waive my cut. Just this once.
…An orc writing back to a human child.
The ancestors would laugh.
…오크는 무섭다. 그건 맞다.\n무서워도 미안해하는 아이라.\n…이 금은:
…Orcs are frightening. That is true.
A child scared, and sorry anyway.
…This notch I must cut differently.
...Well said.
I'll pour a cup for the ancestors
and hand over the leftover coin.
…Why he walked, the cord doesn't say.
Orc knots can't tie a 'why.'
…Sharp ears, my fairy lord.
I'll take that as praise.
...Our law is different.
Then I will repay it next night.
A debt does not vanish.
...It's smiling.
But every time I look,
it smiles a little more.
…I know you're comforting me.
I like it anyway. Say it again.
…은혜는 잊지 않는다.\n이걸 받아라. 늑대의 피다.\n달이 뜨는 밤에:
...I won't forget this kindness.
Take this. Wolf's blood.
Use it on a moonlit night... and you will know.
…Yes.
That's how you keep a load.
…This pack, see.
It's an acorn from that tree.
That's why I never set it down.
…이 집 문은 내가 지키지.\n늦은 값이오.\n드워프는 빚을 오래 기억하:
…I'll guard this door myself.
Late payment.
Dwarves remember a debt a long time.
…Here, in this house,
I sleep.
Like Father's forge.
…이 집의 재는 깨끗하군요.\n스승이 말했어요.\n재가 깨끗한 집은 믿으:
...The ash in this house is clean.
My master said,
trust a house with clean ash.
…이름은 안 물었다.\n물었으면 찾으러 갔겠지.\n그럼 나도 사라졌을 거:
…Never asked her name.
If I had, I'd have gone looking.
Then I'd have vanished too.
...It called a name.
Not yours.
A much older one.
…This answer will pass, I think.
One elder, at least, will smile.
…이번엔 묻소.\n양 우리 걸쇠. 헐겁소.\n…고쳐도 되오?:
…Asking this time.
Fold latch. It's loose.
…May I fix it?
…That's what humans say.
Wolves are different.
Tonight I lie down by the door.
…I have heard 'small'
a hundred times in the forest.
A hundred times, I was the one left standing.
...Sleep well.
I will be awake tonight.
…Whether I did right, the rose knows.
They say that rose still blooms.
Without me.
…I shall.
The forest remembers refusals too.
Long, and gratefully.
…That is all
a gardener has to say.
…My dreams?
…I don't remember. A hundred years.
…My whole collection.
Enough to fill three goblin dens.

…Damn! Ten coins gone.
I'll sweep your yard tomorrow.
Might as well earn the broom's keep.
…좋다 싫다는 작은 말이다.\n오크는 법을 말한다.\n지붕을 빌린 빚은:
…Like and dislike are small words.

A borrowed roof is repaid with the sword.
…Fine, I'll do the acting.
Traders are half players anyway.
…Fine. A button free with each.
That badger

…Good. Short letters

…좋아요. 크게 적을게요.\n'니벨, 수프. 맛있었음.':
…All right. I'll write it big.
'Nivel, soup. Was tasty.'
…What drops on my stall stays there.
…My pouch is light
but my heart is heavy.
Heavy the good way.
...Mistress. I have a favor to ask.
...You're kind, Boss.
Then this is a thank-you.
A few coins.
…지금 올 수 있는 고블린이 없대.\n문서는 내가 갖고 있을게.\n다음에:
...No goblin can come right now.
I'll keep the note.
I'll ask again later.
…지금은 갈 수 없다.\n자리를 비울 형편이 아니다.\n길은 다음에 걷겠:
...I can't go now.
There's no leaving my post.
I'll walk the path another time.
…I didn't guard.
I just didn't bark.
…Load.
One is yours.
…Didn't see who handed it over.
…Build? Me?
And if a sheep gets hurt?
…Chasing him costs three more months.
For that money. The sums don't add.
…창가면 주인 집이잖아.\n그럼 주인이 용서해 주는 거야?:
…The window is the innkeeper's house.
So the innkeeper forgives me?
…By the window.
It'll be seen from the sky.
Grandmother, beside the light.
…처음부터 끝까지 무서웠어요.\n다리가 계속 떨렸어요.\n그건 비밀이에요:
…I was scared start to finish.
My legs kept shaking.
That part's a secret.
…The praise was for the rose.
Today, a little for the Queen too.
…The swords he wouldn't sharpen.
First I've told anyone.
…Lighter now.
...Like snoring.
Very loud and slow.
Something bigger than a bear is sleeping.
…Rabbit. I don't eat rabbit.
…And I'm full today.
…품삯은 못 주는 집이잖소.\n수프로 받으라는 거요?:
…You can't pay wages here.
You'd have me paid in soup?
…Ha! A backward map!
Take the gold, send them to the marsh.
…하. 오크 집에선\n빈손으로 온 놈한테 먼저 퍼 줘.\n너, 그거 어디:
…Hah. In an orc home,
the one who comes empty eats first.
Where did you learn that?
...Yawn. I won't.
But even if I don't dream,
the stone does.
…하암. 알아요.\n이 집 벽이 꾸는 꿈이에요.\n벽이 오래되면 꿈을 꿔:
…Yawn. I know.
It's the dream these walls dream.
Old walls dream.
…Yawn. Tonight I'll sleep, no notes.
Not the walls, the sheep, or me.
…Yawn. Tonight, not sheep.
I'll write the hearth's dream.
It's warm.
…Yawn. Sister Willow,
try talking plain.
You were good at it in my dream.
...Yawn. I've seen this house
in a dream.
Before the door even opened.
...Yawn. Good night.
I hope the stone sleeps well too.
…Yawn. Good night.
To the walls as well.
…But your word is my witness.
The other half I cut tonight.
…하하. 하하하.\n주인, 지금 문 대신 말한 거지?:
…Haha. Hahaha.
Innkeeper, you spoke for the door, yes?
…Got something to say.
A long one.
…Grannies all say the same thing.
Whatever the race.
…Grandpa's strap.
From the day the load was lost.
…Grandpa's load.
Asked on the road.
…Nobody knows.
…Grandpa.
Set his load down once, to drink.
…Never lifted it again.
…Hehe. Granny, did you see?
The north witch ate the first bowl.
…흙을 바꿔야 하오.\n이 숲 전체의 흙을.\n그건 가위로 할 일이 아니:
...The soil must be changed.
The soil of this whole forest.
That is not work for shears.

고물 방책이 저절로 무너졌습니다: The Junk Barricade collapsed on its own
고블린 그라즈의 사촌과 그 사촌의 친구와 그 친구의 사촌들입니다. 밤에: Graz the goblin's cousin, his cousin's friend, and that friend's cousins. Whistle at night and they pour in from somewhere, bite the nearest enemy, and go home at dawn. Mercifully, they do not stay for breakfast.
고블린 그라즈의 사촌과 그 친구들입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나 적에게 놓으: Goblin Graz's cousins and their friends. Place it on the ground or a foe during night combat to call 3 Goblin Lackeys. With 2 or more Goblin Mercenaries, 4 come. Lackeys are weak but rush at nearby foes, and return to the forest when the night ends.
고블린 러스크가 고물로 세우는 허술한 방책입니다. 땅에 놓고 손패의 목재: A shoddy barricade Goblin Rusk builds from junk. Place it on the ground and use 1 timber from your hand to raise it at once. Its health is a low 40, but nearby foes strike it before the Lodge. It collapses by itself at dawn 2 days later.
고블린 러스크가 고물을 쌓아 만든 방책입니다. 못과 끈과 '대충'으로 지: A barricade Rusk the goblin piled up out of junk. Held together by nails, string and 'close enough.' Enemies pound on it before the lodge, probably because it looks like the easier target. It collapses on its own after two days.
고블린 물건은 이틀이면\n무너진다고들 하잖아.\n…다들 그래. 고블린 식:
They say goblin things fall apart
in two days.
…Everyone says it. 'Goblin-made.'
고블린 사냥꾼 피클의 덫 세 개입니다. 땅에 놓으면 둘레에 덫을 깔고,: Three traps from Goblin hunter Pikl. Place it on the ground to lay traps around it; foes who step on them take damage and halt briefly. If you have a Goblin Mercenary, sprung traps are reset every dawn.
고블린 사냥꾼 피클이 아끼는 덫 세 개입니다. 밟으면 발목을 물고 잠깐: Three traps dear to Pikl the goblin hunter. Step on one and it bites the ankle and will not let go for a moment. With a goblin at the lodge they get reset every dawn, though Pikl admits to catching his own foot twice.
How many times has he heard
'goblin-made,' I wonder.
고블린 용병이 있어 새벽마다 다시 깖: Re-laid every dawn with a Goblin Mercenary around
고블린 용병이 터진 덫 %d개를 다시 깔았습니다: A Goblin Mercenary re-laid %d sprung traps
고블린 장사꾼은 처음 번 동전을\n평생 안 써요. 목에 걸죠.\n…그걸:
A goblin trader never spends
his first coin. Wears it on his neck.
…I lost mine in the forest.
An old reckoning
of goblin traders.
고블린 타크가 주머니를 정리하다 넘겨준 자루입니다. 목재인지 가죽인지 고: A sack Tak the goblin handed over while cleaning out his pockets. Timber, pelts or meat, shaking it tells you nothing. Sometimes there is scrap metal mixed in, which Tak calls 'a bonus.'
고블린 타크가 주머니를 정리하며 넘겨준 자루입니다. 낮에 아무 곳에나 놓: A sack Goblin Tak handed over while tidying his pockets. Place it anywhere by day to open it and get 2 to 4 of Timber, Raw Meat, Pelts, and Wool, with scrap metal mixed in now and then.
고블린 타크의 주머니에서 나온 수상한 통입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나 적에: A suspicious canister from Goblin Tak's pocket. Throw it on the ground or a foe during night combat to burst widely and deal damage; struck foes flinch back in fear. There is a 15% chance allies in range are lightly hurt too. With 4 or more Goblin Mercenaries, you gain 2 Dud Bombs after using it.
고블린 타크의 주머니에서 나온 수상한 통입니다. 안에 뭐가 들었는지 타크: A suspicious canister from Tak the goblin's pocket. Even Tak is not entirely sure what is inside. Throw it and it goes off with a bang that sends enemies fleeing, though now and then an ally loses an eyebrow. Goblin-grade 'mostly safe.'
고블린 탐험가는 열을 말해야\n하나를 믿어 줘요.\n그래서 열 배로 말해:
A goblin explorer must say ten
to be believed for one.
So I say it tenfold.
고블린 폭죽 가운데 제대로 안 터진 녀석입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나 적에: One of the Goblin Firecrackers that didn't go off properly. Throw it on the ground or a foe during night combat to deal low damage to foes in a small area and stun them for 2 seconds.
고블린 폭죽 사용(고블린 용병 4명 이상): Using a Goblin Firecracker (4 or more Goblin Mercenaries)
고블린 폭죽 중에 제대로 안 터진 녀석입니다. 버리기는 아깝고 들고 있기: A goblin firecracker that failed to go off properly. Too good to throw away, too nerve-wracking to keep. Toss it and it pops with a small thud, leaving whoever it hits dazed for a moment. Goblins call this a success too.
고블린 피클이 셈을 포기하고 생각해 낸 작전입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나: A plan Goblin Pikl came up with after giving up on counting. Place it on the ground or a foe during night combat and all current Goblin Lackeys charge there, dealing damage proportional to their number. Cannot be used if there are no Lackeys.
고블린 피클이 숫자 세기를 포기하고 생각해 낸 작전입니다. '전부 저기로: The plan Pikl the goblin came up with after giving up on counting. 'Everyone, over there!' That is the whole plan. The more gang members, the better it works; with none, Pikl just stands there looking sheepish.
The more goblins the better.
...Though they eat more.
고블린은 방값을 나눠 내요.\n열둘이 나누면 한 명당…\n…피클한테 물어:
Goblins split the room fee.
Twelve ways, that makes each…
…I'll ask Pikl.
고블린은 원래 도망을 잘해요.\n근데 %s, 안 도망갔대요.\n…바보같이:
Goblins are good at running.
But %s didn't run, they say.
…Stupid. Stupid.
고블린이 끼면 밤에 20초마다 졸개 1마리(최대 3): If a Goblin wears it, summons 1 lackey every 20s at night (max 3)
When a goblin blows it, lackeys come.
고요한 밤이었습니다.\n서리가 창에 꽃을 그렸지요.\n궁정 화가보다 낫더:
It was a quiet night.
Frost drew flowers on the glass.
Better than any court painter.
Almost over.
…Where to, after?
Haven't decided.
The twelfth night is near.
I'm choosing words for the ancestors.
…Short. Loud.
골동품 수집가 말라가 쓰던 작은 저울입니다. 동전을 올리면 무게가 아니라: A tiny scale that belonged to Mala the antique collector. Set a coin on it and it weighs not the metal but 'how much more you could get.' A mercenary carrying it always finds one more coin in a fallen enemy's pocket.
골동품 수집가 말라의 작은 저울입니다. 용병의 장신구 칸에 끼우면 그 용: A small scale belonging to Mala, an antique collector. Fit in a Mercenary's trinket slot to increase the Gold dropped when that Mercenary defeats a foe by 1.
골드 %dG\n숙박비·양털 판매로 벌고 산장 관리·고용·용 공물에 씁니다:
Gold %dG
Earned from lodging fees and wool sales; spent on Lodge Management, hiring and dragon tribute
골드 %dG\n숙박비·양털 판매로 벌고 산장 관리·고용에 씁니다:
Gold %dG
Earned from lodging fees and wool sales; spent on Lodge Management and hiring
골드 %dG · 산 카드는 손패로(가득 차면 주머니) · 침식 카드 %d: Gold %dG · Bought cards go to your hand (Pouch if full) · Corroded cards: %d
Pay gold to hold a festival.
Pay gold to hold a festival.
All mercenaries grow stronger forever.
One who waited for spring in a den.
…This forest holds many debts.
곰! …곰도 워록일 수 있죠!\n워록은 사라졌다잖아요.\n곰으로 변했을지:
A bear! …A bear could be a warlock!
They say the warlocks vanished.
Who's to say they didn't turn into bears!
곰은 겨울에 자야 해.\n근데 이 숲에선 잠이 안 와.\n땅 밑에서 뭐가:
Bears must sleep in winter.
But I can't sleep in this forest.
Something is stirring beneath the ground.
곰일 거라 하셨죠?\n다시 가 봤어요. 곰이었어요!\n…곰이 돌 침대에서:
You said it'd be a bear, right?
Went back. A bear it was!
…Sleeping on a stone bed.
공동체·음식·의식. 약속과 명예를 무겁게 여김: Community, food, ritual. Weighs promises and honor heavily
공용 용병 이벤트(서로 다른 종족 넷 이상): Shared Mercenary event (four or more different races)
공용 용병 이벤트(서로 다른 종족 셋 이상): Shared Mercenary event (three or more different races)
공터에 목재 적립 필요 (%d/%d): Need timber banked in the clearing (%d/%d)
공터에 목재 카드를 적립한 뒤 건설 · 밤에 사냥꾼이 올라가 멀리 쏘고: Build after stockpiling Timber cards in the clearing · At night hunters climb up to shoot far and light the view (Lv 1: 1 hunter · Lv 2: 3 hunters)
Target practice waits till tomorrow.
Today I've got thread to gather.
You exaggerate, Sera.
…It was half a market.
광산 경비로 늙은 퇴역 드워프: A retired dwarf who grew old as a mine guard
No meat in the larder.
My nose knew first.
…Then my stomach.
No meat in the larder?!
You don't say that
to an orc, Innkeeper.
괜찮다고요? 배달부한테\n그건 제일 무서운 말인데…:
All right? For a courier, that's
the most frightening thing…
It's fine! Sour can be fixed.
Ale nobody will drink,
that's what can't be.
괴물에게서 산장을 지키세요: Defend the Lodge from the monsters
괴물이 쉬지 않고 밀려옵니다 — 용 공물을 아끼지 마세요: Monsters pour in without rest — spare no Dragon Tribute
괴물이 쉬지 않고 밀려옵니다 — 용비늘이 있다면 지금입니다: Monsters pour in without rest — if you have a Dragon Scale, now is the time
교역 마차를 호위해 온 용병: A mercenary who guarded a trade wagon
The corner room's free, right?
Tonight I'll sleep with just
my door-side ear up.
The orb's still cold!
It's in my deepest pouch.
국경 수비대가 쓰던 장검입니다. 녹은 슬었어도 날은 아직 서 있고, 손잡: A longsword once carried by the border guard. Rusted, but the edge still holds, and someone's name is half worn off the grip. Put it in a mercenary's hand and their eyes change a little. The witch does not take up swords. That is not her way.
국에 고기가 없소.\n…돌 끓인 국인 줄 알았지.\n돌 맛은 내가 잘 아:
No meat in the soup.
…Thought it was stone broth.
I know the taste of stone.
국이 맑구려. 거울처럼.\n…고기는 바닥났소?:
Clear soup. Like a mirror.
…Out of meat, are we?
국자 들고 왔어요!\n추가 요금 주머니도요!:
Brought my ladle!
And the extra-charge purse too!
굴에 누가 숨었다고요?\n그럼 제가 동굴에서 본 워록도\n거기 숨은 거예:
Someone hid in a den?
Then the warlock I saw in the cave
was hiding there too!
The den is hurt.
When the den hurts, the pack aches.
…Innkeeper. You all right?
굽은 장대 끝에 매단 마녀의 등불입니다. 기름 대신 오래된 약속으로 타오: A witch's lantern hung from a crooked pole. It burns on old promises instead of oil, pushing back the fog and making the things in the dark hesitate. Any guest walking at night likely found the lodge by this light.
굽은 장대에 매단 마녀의 등불입니다. 지면에 설치하면 주변 안개를 걷어: A Witch's lantern hung on a bent pole. Set on the ground, it clears nearby Fog, and foes that enter its light are slowed. If set up beforehand by day, it stays lit until that night's combat ends. There is a limit to how many can be lit at once.
A court rose in a witch's yard.
…The Queen would laugh to hear.
I sent word to the court.
That I'll come in spring.
…Till then, this fence.
궁정에 알려야겠습니다.\n'북쪽 마녀, 서리 거미를 벰.'\n…짧아서 믿:
I must report to the court.
'North Witch slew frost spider.'
…Too short. They won't believe it.
At court we say a name three times.
%s.
…I cannot say it twice.
궁정의 전언은 저도 받았습니다.\n티슬 경은 늘 마지막에\n돌아오는 분이:
I too received the court's word.
Sir Thistle is ever the last
to come home.
About the ear.
…Many have asked.
This is the first answer.
Ears pressed flat.
Not a word.
귀를 접고 두리번대는 토끼 수인: A rabbit beastfolk with folded ears, glancing around
Rules are rules. Take the coin.
그 감독관 말이오?\n지난달 내 좌판에서 깎다가\n동전 하나 떨어뜨리고:
That inspector?
Haggled at my stall last month
and dropped a coin as he left.
That winter.
I remember which winter.
Tell no one else that line.
Saw that ear from the start.
Wolf teeth.
…Didn't ask. Still don't.
그 기록은 어디에 둘 거야?: Where will you keep that record?
그 기록을 더 살펴봐도 될까?: May I take a closer look at those notes?
그 길은 아직 쓸 수 있어?: Can that road still be used?
You should avoid that road for a while.
그 깃털, 창가에 걸까?: Hang the feather by the window?
Through all that chaos,
the lodge held up.
That wood is worth a high price.
Leave that trap as it is.
That cave bear's still asleep.
I tiptoed here.
그 동전 돌려줬어요, 브로크 씨?: Did you give it back, Master Brock?
I'll keep that coin for you.
그 동전으로 고기 사 왔어요.\n솥이 한 바퀴 돌았죠.\n…근데 한 사람:
I bought meat with that coin.
The pot came full circle.
…But one person didn't eat.
그 둥지, 무리도 피해 갔다.\n…주인은 들어갔다.\n이제 주인이 우두머:
Even the pack avoided that nest.
…You went in, Innkeeper.
You lead the pack now.
I've not built since.
Only fell trees.
When you fell, the tree's to blame.
그 들보에 박을 쐐기요.\n삼백 년 버틴 들보에\n백 년을 더 얹는 거지:
A wedge for that beam.
Three hundred years it's held.
This adds a hundred more.
그 등불까지 날 수 있어?: Can you fly to that lantern?
그 등불이요, 기름이 없는데\n왜 타요? 만져 봤어요. 안 뜨거워요.\n:
That lantern, there's no oil,
so why does it burn? I touched it. Not hot.
…Oh, you said don't touch. Forgot.
그 말 벽에도 써 있더라고요!\n좋아요, 추가 요금 낼게요.\n대신 솥은:
It's written on the wall too!
Fine, I'll pay the extra.
But I take the pot. Tonight!
I was waiting for you to say that.
I set it aside in the corner of the barn.
Swept up the sawdust too.
I followed that smooth trail.
Three nights. Three javelins.
그 매듭 표식, 북쪽 고개에서\n본 적 있어요. 바위마다요.\n길잡이 눈:
That knot mark, I've seen it
on the north pass. Every rock.
A guide's eye catches it all.
That voice I spoke of.
Last winter I didn't hear it.
…Not by this house's door.
그 목소리, 아직 들려?: Do you still hear that voice?
그 반 금, 다 그었다.\n주인 말을 증인 삼아.\n…그런데 소식이 왔다:
That half notch, I finished it.
With your word as witness.
…Then word came.
That cheating of yours.
Warm the tea again today.
Tonight, fallen mercenaries
rise again as skeletons.
Tonight all mercenaries hit harder.
Orcs knock foes back.
That night, whose warning did
my grandmother's grandmother hear?
그 벽 앞에서 자 줄 수 있어?: Could you sleep in front of that wall?
That spring, two woke in the den.
Grandpa… and
someone who'd been hiding.
Let me look at that root.
That hunter shoots at night too.
그 서리 거미요? 니벨라?\n죽었다고요? 진짜로요?\n…그 둥지, 뭐 남:
That frost spider? Nivella?
Dead? Really, truly?
…Anything left in that nest?
그 수프가 생각나서 왔소.\n방 하나 비어 있겠지?:
I came back for that soup.
You've got a room free, right?
그 싹, 오늘 아침에도 봤습니다.\n제 키를 넘으려면\n백 년쯤 걸리겠군:
I saw that sprout again this morning.
To grow past my height
will take a hundred years or so.
That child must be grown now.
…Do they still cry at orcs?
That child still
talks about the lantern.
그 애 차는 늘 식어 있다.\n내가 백 번은 데웠지.\n…요리사 말 들어:
That child's tea is always cold.
I've warmed it a hundred times.
…Mind the cook, dear.
We'd better stop talking about that.
그 오소리랑 하루 걸러\n오다 보니… 정이 들었어요.\n말은 하지 마세요:
Coming every other day with
that badger… I've grown fond.
Don't tell anyone.
That rose. The Queen sent it.
No letter. Just the cutting.
That legend.
'Wake twice over in spring.'
I think I get it now.
그 지팡이, 참나무지?\n벼락 맞은 거!\n톱으로 썰면 얼마나 나올까…:
That staff, it's oak, right?
Lightning-struck!
Wonder how much I'd get sawing it up…
그 짐, 내 좌판에 풀어 보시오.\n값은 후하게 쳐 주지.\n오소리끼리:
Unpack that on my stall, friend.
I'll give a generous price.
We're both badgers, aren't we?
That house's door heard you too.
그 집 아이가 보냈다.\n'뒤에서 걷던 오크 아저씨께.'\n…알고 있었다:
The family's child sent it.
'To the orc who walked behind.'
…They knew. From the start.
그 책, 나한테 보여 줄 수 있어?: Could you show me that book?
그 책이요, 다시 봤어요.\n찢긴 첫 장 뒷면에\n눈송이 같은 표식이 남:
I looked at that book again.
On the back of the torn first page
there was a mark like a snowflake.
Don't use that saw for a while.
그, 그렇죠?!\n형님… 아니 마녀님이 그러면\n그런 거죠! 하!:
R-right?!
Boss... I mean, Witch, if you say so,
then that's how it is! Ha!
그, 그림자? 하! 그림자가 뭘 먹어?\n…먹어? 진짜로?:
A-a shadow? Hah! What would it eat?
…Eat? Truly?
He draws breath twice,
as before lifting a hammer.
Surely the loudest sound
a dwarf can know.
그거 제가 날랐어요!\n받는 이가 '뒤에서 걷는 오크'라서\n역참 세 군:
I carried that one!
It was for 'the orc who walks behind,'
so I asked at three waystations!
그거 제가 배달했어요!\n도장 찍힌 거라 안 쉬고 왔어요!\n…쉬긴 쉬었:
I delivered that!
It had a seal, so I didn't stop once!
…Well, I stopped. Seven times.
그건 그렇고! 제안 하나.\n이 산장 좌판 독점 계약.\n저만 팔고, 저:
Anyway! A proposal.
Sole trading rights at this lodge.
Only I sell, only I buy.
That anyone may read.
Even a witch hunter.
That's not an omen, that's a rumor.
그건 지난주 얘기지!\n그 전엔 음유시인, 그 전엔 기사….\n딸꾹. 나:
That was last week!
Before that a bard, before that a knight….
Hic. I've just got a big heart.
그걸 모르겠어요.\n모양도 마개도 전부 같거든요.\n다만 하나만 손에 차:
That's what I can't tell.
The shape and stopper are all the same.
Only one feels cold in my hand.
그걸 빼면 손님이 안 와요!\n고블린은 그 말부터 봐요.\n…저도 그거:
Drop that and nobody comes!
Goblins read that line first.
…It's what brought me here.
